integrity_statement: Derivatives independently checked using exact symbolic angular moments; sixth-order positivity checked by an exact rational interval certificate; the all-positive-series tail establishes uniqueness analytically. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact uniqueness and sixth-order nondegeneracy only for the local variational potential. Neither the source global-shape hypothesis (118), global equilibrium selection, genuine thermodynamic tricritical universality, nor finite-size critical fluctuations are established.
title: Unique sextic Landau degeneracy in a mixed-range Ising chain
